q: a chat tried and failed so that the thread carried the work
w: One sentence says the Sneaky Discord could never coordinate while this build, led from the thread, was fun, and that the member is glad they helped. It is T3-107's 'chat tried and failed', and also a member's own share (T3-003); one concept cannot carry both, and neither test says which leads.

A Discord is opened for defending the logo (T3-014); a member says 'Its over guys just give up' and another answers 'Never', the urging and refusing T3-059's own rule weighs, named by neither reader. No attack is in the words, which T3-005 needs.

Asking for, offering and using Discords leads (T3-014); templates and pixel maps given, scripts offered to maintain the work, arguments that the work was done by hand and not by script, requests for grids, and contact with the Void through its Discord each have three or more concepts: more than three placements carry. Reader B flagged a bag; my B1 T3-070 took one strand.
Members move the planning to Discord and IRC (T3-014); one asks builders to make one megathread 'like civilized people', T3-015's 'members asking for one', a concept of its own.

Moving the flag work into Discord leads (T3-014); calls for numbers, posting links in r/MURICA and other subs, and writing the r/AFIP tag near the flag to funnel people in each have three or more concepts: more than three placements carry. The tag is advertising the sub, which T3-169's must_not_show gives to T3-044.

Sending contributors to the Arch Discord leads (T3-014); the plan spreadsheet with coordinates to follow, and the contact with the Linux group on its IRC channel and with the COSI requester, each have three or more concepts; two report what the Discord made: four themes, more than three placements carry.

The room's Discord is set up and linked (T3-014); the Dutch are invited into it to talk, another room in the chat (T3-153); one reports 'the discord is in agreement' not to destroy their art, the chat's decision relayed (T3-152), named by neither reader.

Four concepts trade repair and room with Square Spiral (mutual patching, spare our flag, a tile now and then, help our border), the larger part, T3-151; one moves organising to Discord (T3-014) and one sends planning to r/AcePlace (T3-090, named by neither reader). Help found in CasualConversation's Discord is one concept, not placed.
A Discord is made for attack coordination (T3-014); a member has applied to r/greenlattice 'to get us a spot for an AU', a request for space to the room that holds it (T3-035).
Members send people to the Discord's voice and text chat to organise (T3-014); three concepts sticky an organising post or ask for one, T3-015 with concepts of its own.

Helpers are sent to the r/bangtan Discord (T3-014); three concepts use the shared 'group discord' and the Seventeen Discord, where another room's work is planned and defended together (T3-153, named by neither reader); one reports the Discord people at work on the B (T3-152).

Belgium's own Discord is opened and builders sent there (T3-014); four concepts use shared or other rooms' chats (FlagAlliance, SaveTheArt, the German Discord's Belgian channel, Pakistan seeking Belgium's chat for the border), another room in the chat, T3-153.

Both readers place T3-014 and reader B flags a bag. Sending people to the Discord leads; the flag templates and grids, explaining one pixel every five minutes, newcomers asking how to help, complaints that everyone proposes a different place, r/placebr, the flag script and calls for help each have three or more concepts. My B1 T3-070 took one strand.
Members are invited into a Discord to cooperate on the EVE logo (T3-014); the same post asks for upvotes on the r/Eve Discord post so it is seen, a vote drive with a concept of its own (T3-051).
Organising moves to Discord (T3-014); a member opens a thread on Racó Català to raise their numbers, the call carried into another community (T3-062).

Members move crest planning to the ChelseaFC Discord and a private chat (T3-014); the chat's discussion of leaving Agumon alone and its design are brought back to the thread (T3-152, conflict CC-015).
Members open Discords for Place (T3-014); moderators send r/place submissions to one megathread (T3-015); one creates r/placecz for the canvas work, a new sub with a concept of its own (T3-090).

Both readers place the Discord moves (T3-014) and the guide and next-pixel directions (T3-070). Two concepts redirect help to the started Solaire and scale the art down to what the small group can finish, a design scaled to the hands (T3-069), my B1 theme, left out by both.

Most concepts set up the chatroom and send people to Discord for the plan (T3-014); the flag-maintenance bot and console code are T3-028; the Pastebin of more than 1,000 shared accounts that built Kaj is placing beyond the limit (T3-088).

Members are sent to #destiny-the-place for live planning (T3-014); three concepts credit and thank its organisers (T3-043, named by neither reader); one reports from the chat that the faction emblems are going up (T3-152).

The room is sent to the r/drugs Discord, another room's server, which the boundary ruled once gives to T3-153 ('visiting theirs, joining a shared server'); both readers read it as the room's own chat.

Collaborators are sent to Discord for live direction (T3-014); one brings back that the Discord agreed on a green background, the chat's decision relayed (T3-152). Withholding the link from the moderators is not hiding the plan from rivals.

Members coordinate in the DF Discord (T3-014); four report what it decided (repair the diamond, no further south, ally-coloured row, it organised the push) (T3-152); three recruit for and adjust the DwarfPlacer script (T3-028).
Helpers are sent to Discord to finish Ness (T3-014); the later concept continues Ness on pxls.space, a successor canvas (T3-054).
Members set up, reissue and send people to the Discord (T3-014); one posts the plan 'agreed on discord', the chat's decision relayed (T3-152); the other updates only send readers to the chat.
